slides.headline: Fight a bad review yourself, or hire someone? The honest answer.
Do it yourself if:
slides.body: it's one obvious spam review, you haven't flagged it yet, and you have a few hours free.

slides.headline: Get help if you've already flagged it and Google said no.
slides.body: Your next attempt matters more than the first.

slides.headline: Or if there are several.
slides.body: Especially if they arrived together or read the same.

slides.headline: Or if it's costing you work.
slides.body: Top of your profile, in front of every new inquiry, every week.

slides.headline: Or if your time is worth more than the fee.
slides.body: For most owners running the business day to day, it is.

slides.headline: Either way: don't reply angry.
slides.body: Every future customer reads your reply before they read anything else.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
